findings.problem: The example uses tomar as an infinitive after quieres, but tomar itself should be conjugated.
findings.fix: example.es: ¿Tomas café en la mañana? / example.en: Do you drink coffee in the morning?

back.es: tomar: to take; to drink, to have (a drink)
back.example: Do you want to have a coffee?

note: The hint "everyday word" is what rules out beber, which is the more formal or written word for "to drink". This matters because many learners will know beber first.
